newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Consmining shares busy on JCI buy.
newsitem.headline: Consmining shares busy on JCI buy.

text.p: Mining and finance holding company Consolidated Mining Corp Ltd shares were firmer in brisk Monday morning trade after news it had bought 4.9 million JCI Ltd shares at 46 rand each, dealers said.
"The buy is going to be positive for the share. There are a lot of jobbers involved," a dealer said.
Consmining was the most actively traded share on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, rising two cents to 91 cents in a volume of nearly 1.6 million shares.
JCI shares added 20 cents to 41.50 rand in thin volume and dealers said it could be related to the share sale.
Consmining said the acquisition emphasised its strategy to enlarge its asset base through appropriate purchases.
